indicators: Donchian 60 entry, 30 exit, 400-bar midrange trend, body>=60% of range, volume>=2x SMA(40)[1], stop = low/high of last 5 bars
entry_long: close>HH60[1] AND body% >= 60 AND volume >= 2*avg AND close > trend mid (400-bar HH/LL midpoint) AND inDate
exit: exit at 30-bar opposite channel or stop
implementation_notes: Pine strategy() script: backtest results depend on TradingView broker emulator (fills, slippage) - not reproducible 1:1. Retrieved source via pine-facade API; my extraction is a lossy summary, read the source before coding.
